grades: Current 9th, 10th and 11th graders (rising sophomores, juniors, seniors)
name: AgriQuest Youth Summer Camp
org: University of Georgia College of Agricultural and Environmental Sciences
what_you_do: Live on the UGA campus for seven days. Join workshops, hands-on labs and talks on farming, food and nature science. Meet people in the job fields.
who_can_apply: Students who finished 9th or 10th grade. You should be truly curious about farming, food, nature science, math and tech.
pay_detail: $300 covers housing, meals, instruction, field trip transport and activities. Full scholarships for accepted students with financial need.
deadline_text: Applications open Nov 2, 2026 and close March 5, 2027. Decisions by March 19, 2027. Camp is June 6 to 12, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form. Add your unofficial transcript and two short essays. Add a recommendation form from one or two teachers or counselors.
notes: Questions: agriquest@uga.edu. Cancel 6 or more weeks ahead for a refund minus $50.
